newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained steady to weaker on Wednesday amid a lack of buying interest, a sharp drop in CBOT grain and oilseed prices and sluggish demand, dealers said.
"It's a dull market," a Buffalo dealer said. "We are seeing pretty flat demand. I think we are anticipating a little bit of lower demand as we go further into June."
He noted less demand for millfeed from the dairy sector. The market was also on the quiet side because of lower milk prices, he said.
In the Southeast, the harvest of the new crop soft red winter wheat was also biting into demand.
"We got new crop wheat trying to move so they are trying to grind wheat," a North Carolina dealer said.
The sharp drop in Chicago Board of Trade grain and soybean prices may have prompted some buyers to stay on the sidelines until the volatility settles down, dealers said.

"It certainly will not help midds. But I think we still have to go another week yet before we see where demand is going," he said. "Things are not real heavy yet but I think it could work into that direction."
